label: Batched CI Doctor
description: Investigate recent CI failures in batches on a schedule and consolidate actionable diagnoses
tips: Query a bounded lookback window of completed GitHub Actions runs and analyze only failures that have not recovered on rerun
Cluster failures by a stable key such as workflow, job, failing step, and normalized error signature before investigating root causes
Keep one stable tracking issue for the batch: search before creating, then add a comment with materially new findings on later runs
Diagnostic only — report evidence-backed root causes and remediation steps, but do not rerun workflows or modify repository code
